main_text.l: suo beneplacito, nullamque in iis quos
elegit rationem aut causam fuisse cur eli-
putetur: nullam in iis quos reprobauit
non pariter existeret in aliis. Adeo ut
sit, nec ulla rei cuiusquam præuisione
pro arbitrio. Ita vt neminem Deus vo-
cet ad fidem in Iesum Christum, qui non
adeo resistere possit ei vocationi, vt eam
ciam, quam Deus exerit in electorum

page.notes: Doubtful reading: "amplectitur" on the last line is [?]; the ligature is hard to read. The end of the second paragraph lies beyond the cut. A small printed mark (an asterisk-like sign) stands in the left margin beside "opinio"; it is a printer's mark, not a note with text. "9./Epistolæ" shows a slash between the number and the title as printed; the reading of this mark is doubtful.
